League (7th/18, 46 behind Ohmbappe 714): no rival squad data in league.json (differentials/template arrays empty). The league template (De Cuyper, Groß, Haaland, Raya, Tavernier) is fully owned, so the league is a template-on-template race. Chase the 46-pt gap through 1-2 differential starters (Ayari/Le Fée), not through a captain fade.
